programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki bring their signature mix of BBQ expertise, playful banter and mouthwatering recipes back to the BBQ Barn. This time, they grill fennel with anchovy garlic butter, roast stuffed apricot Dijon pork chops and serve a vibrant watermelon, feta and black olive salad.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Seafood Skewers & Sweet, Smoky Salsa
programme.desc: Maddie and Kiki are back at the barn with smoky flavours, fresh ideas, and BBQ favourites! On this episode, they make crab cakes with smoky peach salsa, grill swordfish and scallop skewers with curried corn sauce, and toss a grilled vegetable couscous salad.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn

programme.desc: Fresh ingredients meet bold BBQ flavours as Maddie and Kiki put a smoky spin on Mediterranean favourites. They smoke heirloom tomatoes for a basil and bocconcini salad, glaze grilled mushroom kebabs with balsamic, and finish with juicy lamb souvlaki served alongside cool tzatziki.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Smoked Turkey & Sweet Summer Treats
programme.desc: The barn is heating up as Maddie and Kiki serve up a lineup of smoky, savoury, and sweet BBQ favourites! This time, they create their own turkey pastrami, build a spinach salad with bacon and cashews, and turn grilled pineapple into a delicious campfire-inspired treat.

programme.title: Maddie and Kiki's BBQ Barn
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Fish, Fire & Fruity Flair

programme.desc: Host Tyrone Edwards reveals to Brazil-born Iafa Almeida Cac that she has roots from other places. Alongside an expert chef, Iafa cooks a recipe that blends fresh ingredients from her Brazilian and newfound culture.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Host Tyrone Edwards takes PJ Kerr on a journey to discover his ancestry and meets with an expert chef to learn more about his newfound roots.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Bianca Osbourne is shocked by host Tyrone Edwards who reveals a whole new side of her family history.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: After revealing his DNA results, host Tyrone Edwards accompanies Jacob Ahee on a journey of self-discovery as he explores his newfound roots through food.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: From Fettuccine Alfredo to Meatloaf, everyday recipes are enjoyed every day for a reason: we love them! Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim use spices to punch up these classic recipes. Meatloaf gets aromatic allspice, and is topped with bay leaf spiked ketchup. Fettuccine gets mustard; both the seed and the leafy green! Bacon and fried rice are ultimate comfort foods, but have you ever tried it with cardamom in the mix? Spice is the secret, a pinch of spice can make a world of difference!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Cook along with Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim as they delve into all things anise! First, they get things rolling with an apple, fennel, and radish salad with a star anise spiked vinaigrette! Next up, Baked Mac and Cheese gets a duo of fennel: the vegetable and the seed! Finally, a pork tenderloin with a simple mixed berry sauce. Where's the fennel you ask? They rub the pork with fennel-cousin cumin for some smoky aroma and flavour! Remember"... a pinch of spice makes a world of difference!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim have picked a peck of peppery recipes this time on Spice Secrets! Start off with something sweet: strawberry shortcakes featuring three different peppercorns: black, white, and pink! After that, a Japanese take on Tuna Ceviche when they infuse a trio of smoky Mexican chili peppers into citrusy ponzu sauce! And who can resist crispy fried chicken wings? Especially when they're spiced up with Chinese five-spice and served with a Sichuan pepper hot honey!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: If mace, fenugreek, and cloves aren't at the front of your spice shelf yet, they will be by the end of this episode! Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim bring these spices to a trio of fabulous recipes! First, octopus gets a slow bath in mace-scented olive oil before picking up a smoky char on the grill. A refreshing Thai Mango Salad gets amped up with the big flavour of fenugreek. Lastly, lamb chops get treated to an aromatic marinade of clove-spiked basil and parsley pesto.

programme.title: Let's Brunch
programme.desc: Brunch is the most important meal of the weekend! Join host Vanessa Gianfrancesco as she whips up healthy and delicious recipes that'll awaken your taste buds.

programme.title: Let's Brunch
programme.desc: Pancakes are a classic brunch staple, but host Vanessa Gianfrancesco whips up her twist on this traditional dish with savoury, sweet and crunchy recipes.

programme.title: Let's Brunch

programme.desc: Skip the utensils and gather for chef Vanessa's pick up your brunch! Featuring Sticky Pull-Apart Praline Bread and an extra cheesy Monte Cristo Sandwich.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Jesse Magallanes was raised in an Argentinian household, but he knows there's more to his ancestry. Host Tyrone Edwards reveals the results of his DNA test and Jesse begins his journey of self-discovery.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Chelsea Richards comes from a Jamaican family but suspects there is more to her ancestry. Host Tyrone Edwards gives her the shock of her life when he reveals the results of her DNA test.

programme.title: DNA Dinners

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Adopted Tara Broadbent is shocked by the results of her DNA test and learns more about her biological ancestry through food.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim explore the relationship between spices and fats in three rich recipes. Juicy watermelon gets treated two ways: as a sauce and as a spicy pickle, both to top a caraway-infused Panna Cotta! Next, a lesson in infusing spice into compound butters: a zingy Za'atar and Lemon Butter for bread and a smoky Paprika and Bay Butter for Grilled Steak! Finally, flaky cod gets basted in juniper and rosemary butter before being sat on a bed of du puy lentils!

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: On this sweet episode of Spice Secrets, chef/hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud cook three dishes that all represent the sweeter side of cooking with spice, though not in the way you'd expect! You'll never see donuts the same way again after trying Chocolate-Glazed Coriander Donuts"... with a Cilantro-Lime filling! Next, Asian Spring Rolls and Plum Sauce meet both Spanish Smoky and Hungarian Sweet Paprikas! Finally, a truly unique dish that can only be described as Duck Meets Vanilla.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.desc: Every cook needs to learn their Mother Sauces before they can claim the title of Chef. Spice Secrets co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim are no different, though their sauce recipes sure are! First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: Spice Secrets
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 The Root of all Spices
programme.desc: Co-hosts Jasmin Ibrahim and Shahir Massoud get to the "root" of spicing up your food as they cook dishes using spice roots! First up, they prepare a creamy Carrot and Galangal Soup, however they don't use cream, opting for cashews instead! Next up, a frosty, golden Turmeric Semifreddo, studded with jewel-like apricots and pistachios! Last but not least is a steaming bowl of mussels, spiced with not one, not two, but three kinds of ginger! How can you not 'root' for these dishes?

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: Fun and quirky host Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode by showing off his knife skills as he sabres a pineapple to start his instant classic; Grilled Fruit Salad. The pineapple joins a mix of bright summer fruits on the grill, then berries, spicy citrus vinaigrette and savoury feta cheese. Next up, Spencer whips up his Hawaiian Chicken recipe. Spiced with cayenne and Chinese five spice, Spencer stuffs flavourful chicken thighs with pineapple and grills it with a delightful ginger and soy sauce. Every bite is sweet, savoury, and fresh - exactly how summer should taste! Then Spencer shares his top tips for adding smoky flavours to pork using an easy and handy smoke pouch. His Apple Smoked Pork Tenderloin is bathed in a fog of applewood smoke and he then tops it with tart apple-blueberry compote. Cinnamon buns are amazing with a bit of orange peel - but have you ever had them in an orange peel and on the grill? That's right and Spencer shows you how you can make fun and flavourful Orange Peel Cinnamon Buns on the barbecue using indirect heat.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: First up, Belgium is famous for its mussels and fries, aka 'Moule Frite'. Chef Wong has a unique take featuring Belgian beer steamed mussels salad, waffle cut fries, and potato-leek mousse. Next, Steak Madagascar is an old school fine-dining fave, this take, uses modernist 'spherification' for the sauce, and a vanilla bean rub for a steak that is decidedly not 'old school', wow! For a common ingredient, how about sweet breakfast? Belgians are famous for Liege Waffles, and Madagascar loves Mofogasy, a pancake made with rice flour and coconut. The final dish is inspired by Belgian Waterzooi, a root veggie stew, mixed with a popular Malagesy stir-fry with shellfish and pork... Chef carefully and skillfully balances all the elements, using lobster, bacon breadcrumbs, and adding a modern touch with mango pickle 'pearls'!

programme.title: Spice Secrets

First, a traditional Tomato Sauce re-examined as a Bucatini All'Amatriciana spiced with Quatre Épices! Next, a rich veal Demi-Glace spiced two different ways, served with veal chops and Roasted Mushrooms! Finally, a spin on a classic Béarnaise Sauce, replacing tarragon with Aniseed.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Rotterdam"

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Girona"

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Desert"

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Berlin"

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: DJ-producer Carly Foxx travels to the clubbing capital of the world to inspire her music track and discovers Ibiza’s alternative spiritual side.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Europe"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx looks back at her journey to the music dance capitals of Europe to inspire her final track.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Manitoba"
programme.desc: Michael eats and explores his way through Winnipeg, tries curling, and takes a road trip that ends at a relaxing outdoor spa.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Saskatchewan"
programme.desc: Michael visits a farm in Saskatchewan, celebrates his birthday on a road trip, trains with a football team, and stays at a retreat.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "Alberta"
programme.desc: Michael visits an Alberta ranch, sees the snowy Rockies, stays at a rail hotel, and visits the Badlands and a giant mall.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "United Kingdom"

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Philadelphia"
programme.desc: Yann immerses himself in Philadelphia's skateboarding culture. He explores Nocturnal Skate Shop eats a Philly cheesesteak, visits Cloud 9 pottery studio, admires Adam's art collection, skates with Celina, and experiences the creativity of FDR.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "St. Petersburg"
programme.desc: Yann explores St. Petersburg's skateboarding community, visiting Anchor Skate shop and meeting Jay Turner, Kris Markovitch, Jake White, Naomi Glueck, Evan Starkey, and Alex Charos. He highlights creativity, self-expression, and the vibrant community.

programme.title: A Simple Path: The Worldwide Ride
programme.desc: Skateboarding and its do it yourself lifestyle has permeated into the worlds of art, music, and fashion. The constant progression and search for the new, attracts unique individuals from all walks of life.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "British Columbia"

programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Riding America’s newest and oldest railways
programme.desc: Starting in Key West, Michael heads north to find the first tracks of his journey, riding the nation's newest and oldest railways.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s steepest and longest railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Riding America’s steepest and longest railways
programme.desc: The quest for the northernmost station continues as Michael tackles the steepest grades and longest railway stretches in the country.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Los Angeles"

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Seattle / Vancouver"

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "New York City"

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Oakland"

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Texas"

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Garden Route"

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. Starring Sally Payne as Calamity Jane, and Rogerss ongoing sidekick George Gabby Hayes, this twofisted saga relives some of Americas most colorful days, and also has time for a few musical numbers, including Up and Down the Prairie, and When the Shadows Fall Across the Rockies.

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: With Sitting Bull at the Spirit Lake Massacre
programme.desc: A long-thought-lost film finally surfaces after being unseen for over eight decades. Created and copyrighted by Sunset Productions in 1925 but not released until June 15, 1927, this silent epic features the superior Native American actor Chief Yowlachie (performing here under the name Chief Yowlache) as Sitting Bull. Other fine actors in the cast include the always popular Bryant Washburn and a young Bob Steele, who appears under his real name Bob Bradbury Jr. The story takes place in the 1860s or 1870s near Spirit Lake, Iowa. Settlements of whites are growing in that region but the Sioux Indians also have professed their interest in one such settlement. Chief Sitting Bull surveys the settlement at Spirit Lake from afar and with the advice of the Great Spirit vows to retake the land that belonged to his fathers.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: In this episode, the scourge of the Southwest is a ruthless and devious killer known as the Sidewinder. When a hapless Cavalryman escorting the criminal falls victim to his tricks, Pat and Sonny set out to track him down and bring him in. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. This episode, Stolen Dynamite, stars Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. In this episode, the G-men nab a beautiful spy.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are ordered to Nugget City to tear down a toll-gate on federal land. They are opposed by a woman mayor who uses the gate to keep out riff-raff and raise money for the town's growing needs. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney are sent to Texas when it is discovered that a large number of Federal Gold Bonds held by the State of Texas are counterfeit. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe (Charles Lane) threatens to close down the Cannonball on Christmas Eve, disrupting the Shady Rest hotel's holiday plans. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Directed by Guy Scarpita. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: When Herby (Don Washbrook) gets drafted, Kate tries to cheer him up by saying he could become an astronaut. Could hooterville actually send someone ito the space program? Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Bobbie Jo and the Beatnik
programme.desc: Bobbie Jo falls head over heals for an edgy young poet from New York. He likes her, too, but he's not fond of Hooterville. Of coure, Kate has to show Bobby Jo what this pompous fool is all about. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963. Look for Dennis Hopper as the beatnik.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 My Daughter the Doctor
programme.desc: The family wants Billie Jo to become a doctor, but she wants to go to Hollywood to become an actress. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. And be sure to look for Adam West in a pre-Batman role as Doctor Clayton Harris. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in January, 1964.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: When the towns doctor is unable to save his own father, he loses confidence in his work. Annie tries to convince him that Diablo needs him. Can Annie help him reclaim his confidence? Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Link and Evie Tabor, struggling to work their ranch after a rodeo accident leaves Link in a wheelchair, find themselves vulnerable to outlaws. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This entertaining western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which received a Primetime Emmy Award nomination in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: When the Peters family, seemingly angry at the world and desiring nothing but to be left alone, arrives in Diablo, Annie, Tagg and Lofty try to find out what is making the Peters family act so hostile. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: A young bank teller is in trouble after a beautiful woman robs the bank. Annie steps in to try and prove the young bank tellers innocence. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: An ex-convict is trying to work as a rancher, but his outlaw brother wants him to resume his life of crime. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Annie and Lofty attempt to help Ralph and Mary claim a fertile piece of land after a section of land is opened for settlement. A pair of crooks are aware of the lands value and intend to take it for themselves. Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which earned a Primetime Emmy Award nomination in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Annie and the Twisted Trails
programme.desc: Feeling envious about Annies freedom and trick riding skills, Della runs away from home to see her boyfriend when the rodeo comes to town. While on her own, she meets a couple that secretly wants to rob her father.Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. Also starring Carolyn Craig, Ewing Mitchell, and Myron Healey. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Adventures of Annie Oakley
programme.desc: Tensions rise as a range war over water seems inevitable. A masked man dressed as Robin Hood tries to help the homesteaders by knocking down the ranchers fences. Things seem to be going well until a similarly dressed imposter robs the Diablo bank.Annie Oakley: Gail Davis, Deputy Craig: Brad Johnson, Tagg Oakley: Jimmy Hawkins. This western adventure series aired from 1954-1957. Cowboy star Gene Autrey was an executive producer for the show, which was niominated for a Primetime Emmy Award in 1955.

programme.title: Jesse James Rides Again
programme.desc: The outlaw Jesse James and his friend are on the run from the law when he is wrongly accused of leading the historic 1876 Northfield, Minnesota bank robbery. With nerve-tensing turns and high-impact action, Jesse rides into a town where a gang is trying to drive area ranchers off their land because there's oil underneath it. Jesse James takes particular interest in the situation of a pretty young woman and her elderly father, whose ranch is being regularly attacked by the gang.

programme.title: Randy Rides Alone
programme.desc: John Wayne was 27 when he starred in this vintage western drama from Hollywoods Poverty Row. He plays Randy Bowers, a man wrongly jailed for murders. With help from a female friend, he breaks out of prison and sets out to find the real killers. Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons, Rustlers Paradise) directs a strong cast of familiar faces, including legendary sidekick George Gabby Hayes, Earl Dwyer, and one of the hardest ridin stuntmen turned actors, Yakima Canutt.

programme.title: Loser's End
programme.desc: This spine-tingling drama of the west stars Jack Perrin as a man out for revenge against an outlaw gang. Other stars include Tina Menard as the woman who helps him along the way, and Elias Lazoroff as the daring Don Carlos. Perrin (Jaws of Justice, The Apache Kid's Escape), was a familiar face in low budget westerns, his career spanning back to the silent era.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: Fighting Caravans
programme.desc: Clint Belmet (Gary Cooper) is a frontier scout with his hands full in this 1931 Paramount Pictures version of Zane Grey's novel. He's helping guide a wagon train across the country, fighting off various attacks on the way, and falling for his lovely Felice (Lily Damita). Belmet's grizzled companions think he should leave the woman alone, but it gets lonely out on the trail, and Felice's charms are hard to resist. Featuring such notable character actors of the period as Ernest Torrence, Tully Marshall, and Fred Kolher, this vintage Hollywood Western still packs a wallop!

programme.title: Land of Hunted Men
programme.desc: A band of outlaws is terrorizing a town in the West. Leave it to Ray Crash Corrigan and his Range Busters to ride in and save the day. This film marked the return of Corrigan to the famous series; he had appeared in the first sixteen movies but left for a brief hiatus following 1942's ARIZONA STAGECOACH. This was the 21st of 24 movies in the Range Busters series. Produced between 1940-1943, the Range Busters were a huge financial success for Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Painted Desert
programme.desc: A mightly melodrama of red-blooded action, William Boyd stars in the Pre-Code western talkie - The Painted Desert (1931). The first sound film for Hollywood heavyweight Clark Gable, The Painted Desert finds Boyd and Gable at odds over the affections of a cowboy's beautiful daughter (Helen Twelvetrees).

programme.title: Fugitive of the Plains
programme.desc: In this continuation of the much loved Billy the Kid serials featuring dreamboat Buster Crabbe (perhaps best known for his numerous appearances as Flash Gordon in the 30s and 40s), Billy finds himself joining an outlaw band led by women in order to, once again, clear his name after being wrongly accused of a crime he did not commit. Helmed by famed B-movie director Sam Newfield, this film also features Al St. John, whose lovable Fuzzy character was as essential to the PRC's Billy the Kid series as Billy himself.

programme.title: Revenge of the Virgins (Edited Version)
programme.desc: The angry and topless female members of a Native American prepare for battle when white treasure hunters move in on their sacred ground. Peter Perry Jr. (The Secret Sex Lives of Romeo and Juliet) directed this early nudie-cutie from a script by legendary cult filmmaker Ed Wood (Plan Nine from Outer Space). Writing under the pen name Peter LaRoche, Wood churned out this screenplay just before he reinvented himself as the author of seedy adult novels.

programme.title: Broadway to Cheyenne
programme.desc: A gang of big-city thugs trying to set up a protection racket out west meet their match in this B-Western from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Rex Bell, billed on the old print ads as The heroic idol of young America! stars as Breezy Kildare, a New York detective who happens to be in Wyoming. When Breezy leads a group of cattleman against the well-armed city boys, the bad guys will wish theyd stayed in New York! The rest of the cast includes such favorites from the period as George Gabby Hayes, Roy DArcy, and Marceline Day. (Day worked opposite everyone from John Wayne to Buster Keaton, but retired from acting shortly after this movie at age 25.) Directed by Harry L. Fraser.

programme.title: Raiders of the Border
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Nevada Jack McKenzie (Johnny Mack Brown) and Sandy Hopkins (Raymond Hatton) go undercover to catch jewelry smugglers in this vintage western from Monogram Pictures. This was one of the last films directed by John P. McCarthy (Song of the Gringo, The Oklahoma Cyclone), while Johnny Mack Brown would go on to find great success as Nevada Jack; this was the fourth of 19 films where he played the crime busting marshal.

programme.title: The Dude Ranger
programme.desc: Its nothing but action and thrills when an Easterner inherits a cattle ranch and discovers that thousands of cattle have been stolen. Secretly, he signs on as a hired hand at his own ranch to uncover the thief. Once he realizes whats going on, the city boy becomes a hard-riding, avenging son of a six- shooter! Directed by Edward F. Cline from a story by Zane Grey, the film stars George OBrien, Irene Hervey, and LeRoy Mason.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. In Ghost Bushwackers, the G-Men are authorized by the Army to do undercover work in the lawless Arizona territory.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan. In this episode, the G-Men seek out stolen gold.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, the G-Men are sent to the Ozarks to track down gold stolen from the U.S. Government. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: An outlaw gang is stealing gold from Chinese placer miners, then driving off their claims with outrageous taxes. Because they're Chinese, they can't sue the local government agents. With Stoney posing as a Chinese miner and Pat pretending to be a representative of an Eastern engineering company, the U.S. government tries to bring an end to the careers of the outlaw gang and crooked state government agents.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Billie Jo recieves an endowment, but instead of using it for medical school, she wishes to go to Hollywood.Kate meets with Judge Drucker to see if she can legally prevent the girl from goinng. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Visit from a Big Star
programme.desc: A famous movie star (John Vivyan) stays at the Shady Rest Hotel. He wants to get away from the spotlight for a while, but it appears that Uncle Joe has told the entire valley that the hotel has a special guest. .Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Ralph Levy. Episode first aired January 28, 1964

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Uncle Joe tries to convince two rich women that Shady Rest is a farm. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Guy Scarpitta..Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aried in February of 1964.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 The Very Old Antique
programme.desc: Homer Bedloe (Charles Lane) tries to sell the Cannonball to a rich man as an antique.Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Directed by Jean Yarbrough. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1964.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Bill Davis is killed and the Judge and Jeff track the killers to Mexico. They are joined by rancher John Gorman, who is suspiciously eager to instantly hang those responsible. Two mysterious riders complicate things. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West.In this episode, Miguel, a young Mexican, inherits a silver mine from his father. After the Rio Grande changes course and the mine becomes part of United States territory, two con men stake a claim on it. Judge Bean wants to help Miguel, but the law is on the side of the bad guys. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.sub-title: S01 : E31 The Wedding of Old Sam
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In The Wedding of Old Sam, the judge tries to do a favor for an old friend, but he finds himself involved in a marriage proposal and a somewhat illegal impersonation. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, one of Judge Bean's friends is forced to translate a map by two outlaws. They stole the item from Chinese miners and the Judge must save his pal without endangering his life. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West.In this episode, Judge Bean suspects that Doc Malone's Medicine Show may be harboring a notorious killer. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, an infamous and dangerous train robber escapes from prison, and the Judge sets out to capture him and send him back. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: In this episode, Mr. Kenyon and his children stumble upon a cache of gunpowder in an abandoned cabin. They take the news to Judge Bean angering Holman who plans on handing the explosives to the hostile Mescaleros. The lawmen must keep it from happening. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Judge Roy Bean Collection
programme.desc: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, Doc resorts to drastic measures as he desperately seeks money to fund his free public clinic. Starring Edgar Buchanan, Jack Beutel, and Jackie Laughery.

programme.title: Custer's Last Stand
programme.desc: The survivor of an Indian attack acquires a rare medicine arrow, and a menacing character named Blade (Reed Howes) will stop at nothing to take it from him. Elmer Clifton (Assassin of Youth, Seven Doors to Death) directs a memorable cast that includes Rex Lease (The Sign of the Wolf, The Monster Walks), Lona Andre (Slaves in Bondage, Death in the Air), and William Farnum (Samson and Delilah). Meanwhile, Frank McGlynn Jr is in the title role of General George A. Custer.

programme.title: Northwest Trail
programme.desc: Mountie Matt OBrien assignment is simple: He is to escort the rather grouchy, and slightly annoying, Miss Katherine Owens to a remote outpost. Things complicate however when they arrive at the outpost and he stumbles upon an illegal mining operation. Stars include Bob Steele, Joan Woodbury, and Poodles Hanneford.

programme.title: Winds of the Wasteland
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this Republic Pictures western about the final days of the Pony Express. Former rider John Blair (Wayne) enters a coach race to win a $25,000 government mail contract, but there are dozens of obstacles in his path. The rest of the cast includes Lane Chandler and Phyllis Fraser, plus Lew Kelly (Lady of Burlesque) doing a great comic turn as Rocky OBrien, the eccentric, self-proclaimed mayor of a deserted mining town.

programme.title: Doomed Caravan
programme.desc: Hoppy is enlisted to help protect Jane Travers' next caravan against robbers who have been terrorizing travelers. He comes across a wily pair of thieves who hve their men disguised as soldiers to escort the caravan. Hoppy isn't fooled for a second and busts up their plan with help from the Bar 20 boys. Not to be outdone, the thieves then capture everyone but Hoppy and puts them before a firing squad. Not it's up to Hoppy to rescue his friends singlehandedly. The cast includes William Boyd as Hopalong Cassidy, with Russell Hayden and Andy Clyde as Luky Jenkins and California Jack. For those counting, this was the 32nd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. They would be edited for syndication on television, bringing Hoppy and his friends to a whole new generation of fans.

programme.title: Ghost Town Gold [The Three Mesquiteers]
programme.desc: CAVALIERS OF THE CACTUS COUNTRY--ALWAYS READY FOR A FIGHT OR A FROLICK! The second entry in what would grow into a wildly popular series of Western Three Mesquiteers B-Movies produced by Republic Pictures, Ghost Town Gold tracks the titular trio as they attempt to recover the gold stolen by a gang in its effort to ruin the bank/mayor who ordered them to leave town. Frequent John Wayne collaborator Joseph Kane adds his signature directorial panache to this rousing shoot-em-up, setting the tone for a film series that was so rampantly successful, it spawned 50 sequels and a host of imitators from rival studios.

programme.title: Courageous Avenger
programme.desc: Gold, gangs, and the heroic fight for life! Johnny Mack Brown (Billy the Kid, Coquette) stars in this western thriller about murders going on in a mining community. Its a story full of twists, where the greed for gold is only surpassed by the struggle for life!

programme.title: Outpost In Morocco
programme.desc: George Raft, Mary Windsor, and Akim Tamiroff star in this romantic drama from director Robert Florey (The Florentine Dagger, Daughter of Shanghai). Raft plays Capt. Gerard, a member of the Foreign Legion known for his romantic entanglements. He's assigned to escort an emir's daughter to her father's mountain citadel and learn about the emir's activities. Not surprisingly, Gerard finds trouble brewing! With footage shot in Morocco, this movie also features a beautiful musical score by twotime Oscar nominee Michel Michelet (Voice in the Wind).

programme.title: Between Men
programme.desc: When his young son is shot, John Wellington kills the culprit and flees. But his son Johnny recovers and is raised by Sir George. Some twenty years later Johnny sets out to find Sir George's missing granddaughter. He finds her and also finds Rand, but neither of the two men realize they are father and son.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Arizona Thunderbolt
programme.desc: When Sue Bixby becomes his new boss, stagecoach robber Talbot reforms and goes after her rustled cattle. When he and his men are outnumbered fighting Lloyd's gang, Randall rides to get circus man Mahoney and his man shooting cannon.

programme.title: Diamond Trail
programme.desc: Diamond Trail is an epic that starts in the speeding taxicabs and illegal barrooms of the east coast, and travels west for its exciting climax. Reporter Speed Morgan (Rex Bell), going undercover as Frisco Eddy, infiltrates Flash Barrett's gang in order to bring them all to justice. But can he get the job done before they learn his identity? With a cast that includes Frances Rich and Bud Osborne, this action tale from director Harry L. Fraser (The Last of the Clintons) is another forgotten classic from Monogram Pictures.

programme.title: Son of the Renegade
programme.desc: Johnny Carpenter (who also wrote the screenplay) stars as Red River Johnny, a gunslinger returning to his home town to clear his name of some heinous accusations. This low budget howler was the only feature directed by Reg Brown, who was better known as an editor and a director of television shows. If Ed Wood directed a western, it might have looked like this one. Enjoy!

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: A rancher is shot dead after discovering oil on his property. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog..The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951 .It was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt. This episode aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: An ex-con is released from prison seeking vengeance against those who put him there. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode first aired in 1950.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho work to uncover a cattle rustling operation.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog..The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951. This episode aired in 1950. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho investigate when a railway detective is found dead.Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951 This episode first aired in 1950.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detectives Matt and Frankie make their way to the town of Coffeyville where they run into the Dalton brothers who are seeking to commit a double bank robbery. Also starring Myron healey, Robert Bray and Robert Foulk. Look for future Daniel Boone/Davy Crocket star Fess Parker as a member of the Dalton gang. Episode originally aired in 1954.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Detective Matt Clark and his partner Frankie head to Tombstone, Arizona to find Doc Holliday with suspicion that Holliday is involved in the gang activity there. Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Kim Spalding, Frank Richards, James Craven amd Harry Harvey. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired in 1954. Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: Following their activity with the Quantrill Raiders, the Younger Brothers return on the scene to commit a bank robbery in Minnesota. Detectives Matt and Frankie work to put a stop to their plan. Starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, George Wallace, Gregory Walcott, Louise Beavers, and Sheb Wooley. Directed by William Witney. Epsiode originally aired in 1954.Series won an Emmy in 1955.

programme.title: Stories of the Century
programme.desc: The notorious John Wesley Hardin kills two people while on a cattle drive to Abilene. Matt and Frankie head out to bring him to justice. Richard Webb stars as John Wesley Hardin. Also starring Jim Davis, Mary Castle, Howard Negley, Robert Karnes amd John Eldredge. Directed by William Witney. Episode originally aired April 9, 1954.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After Farmer Perkins murders a store clerk in front of his wife, and is allowed to walk after his trial, the Cartwright's step in to make sure he'll be rearrested, tried, and hung.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After the Virginia City bank is robbed by an outlaw gang, the gangs youngest member gets a job on the Ponderosa. Initially welcomed, Little Joe becomes suspicious of Ponderosas newest member.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life from two gunmen, he explains that he is in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwright's to San Francisco to testify in a statewide racketeering trial, but the Deputy Marshal's motives for the witness soon become suspicious.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort. From 1960.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: With Tom Edwards ranch going to waste since his becoming a paraplegic following an accident with Ben, Ben makes a business proposition: The Cartwrights will build a mill on Edwards land. In return, Ben requests that he earn his investment money back as well as fifteen percent. The deal is made, but suspicions of Edwards accident bring tension to Ponderosa and put their agreement at risk.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Wagon Wheels
programme.desc: Randolph Scott (Ride the High Country) stars as Clint Belmet, the leader of a wagon train on the way to Oregon. Along the route he and his crew deal with various hardships, including Indian attacks and a fellow named Murdock (Monte Blue) who is out to stop them at any cost. With a cast that includes the likes of Gail Patrick and Billy Lee, this adventure saga was based on a novel by the western master, Zane Grey (Riders of the Purple Sage, Fighting Caravans). Trivia note: The film's original title was Caravans West.

programme.title: Billy The Kid Returns
programme.desc: Who would ever mistake Roy Rogers for Billy the Kid? That's exactly what happens in this actionpacked horse opera from Republic Pictures. Rogers arrives on the scene shortly after Pat Garrett (Wade Boteler) kills the infamous Billy the Kid (also played by Rogers). Though Billy was a killer, he was on the side of the homesteaders against a coterie of big time ranchers. As Billy's death is unknown to the public, Roy gets Garrett to let him pose as Billy to continue the fight against the ranchers, but without the bloodshed. We also get six songs, including When the Sun is Setting on the Prairie...

programme.title: Colorado
programme.desc: Theres trouble out west! Its the Civil War and the Union needs troops back east to defend itself. Roy Rogers stars as Lieutenant Jerry Burke, who is sent to investigate why the returning troops are being stalled in Colorado. Also starring Gabby Hayes, Pauline Moore, and Milburn Stone, this film is action packed with a turn you wont see coming!

programme.title: Man from Utah
programme.desc: WHIRLING ROPES AND SNARLING GUNS IN THE GALLOPING GRIP OF A GLAMOROUS DRAMA! John Wayne stars as John Weston, a man hired to investigate shady doings at a local rodeo. It seems all the riders who are on the verge of winning end up dead. Along with Wayne, this tale of action on the range also stars the usual Lone Star Picture stock company, including Gabby Hayes and Yakima Canutt!

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: John Wayne plays a man wrongly convicted of murder in this exciting western drama from Lone Star Pictures. You'll enjoy plenty of gun action and thundering hoofbeats as he escapes from jail and then joins a gang, hoping to find the real killer! Director Armand Schaefer (The Miracle Rider, The Lost Jungle) whips up some fine performances from a cast of B-movie favorites, including Lane Chandler (Samson and Delilah) and the great stunt rider, Yakima Canutt. And of course, the film features plenty of fight scenes, made memorable by John Wayne's big swinging' right fist! For film buffs: This was one of 11 films Wayne starred in that year, making 1933 one of the busiest years of Wayne's legendary career.

programme.title: Rage at Dawn
programme.desc: Randolph Scott plays James Barlow, an agent from Chicago hired to bring the notorious Reno brothers to justice. But wouldnt you know it? The Reno gang includes a beautiful young woman (Mala Powers), who catches Barlows eye. This western from director Tim Whelan (The Thief of Bagdad) features cinematography by two-time Oscar winner Ray Rennahan (Gone With The Wind), while the screenplay was by noted author Horace McCoy (They Shoot Horses, Dont They?). Theres also an all-star cast, including Forrest Tucker, J. Carrol Naish, Edgar Buchanan, Denver Pyle, and several other shaggy sidewinders!

programme.title: Malini Angelica Lisbon
programme.desc: Malini Angelica explores Lisbon, the vibrant capital of Portugal. Once founded by the Phoenicians and shaped by Romans, Moors, and explorers of the Golden Age, Lisbon’s layered history is reflected in its culture and charm. During her visit, the city comes alive with the Festas Populares de Lisboa — a June celebration of Saint Anthony filled with music, dancing, and barbecued sardines. Malini samples local favorites like grilled sardines, bifanas, and the famous pastel de nata, and experiences the soulful beauty of Fado music. Lisbon’s warmth, flavor, and festive spirit show why it remains one of Europe’s most beloved cities.

programme.desc: Nieuwsgierigheid brengt Nieuwsgierige Smurf naar het hol van de Heksenzussen. En Gargamel wil de twee heksen bedriegen terwijl hij probeert de Smurfen te vernietigen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E94 De Smurfen: Een Dagje Smurfin
programme.desc: Potige Smurf verkleedt zich als Smurfin om een verliefde kabouter genaamd Piltkin weg te lokken van het Smurfendorp.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E68 De Smurfen: Eind Goed Al Goed
programme.desc: Gargamel's diefstal van het goud van de feeën heeft bijna een staat van oorlog tussen de feeën en de Smurfen tot gevolg.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E75 De Smurfen: Gelukkig Smurffeest
programme.desc: De Smurfen redden twee kinderen en hun opa als een geheimzinnige vreemdeling hun slee laat omvallen. Ze kloppen op Gargamels deur om hulp te vragen en dan wordt het pas echt gevaarlijk…

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E59 De Smurfen: Grote Smurfs Huwelijksdag
programme.desc: Wanneer de bloemenfee Nymph in het Smurfendorp arriveert, vallen alle Smurfen voor haar charme en gevatheid. En al snel leren ze dat zij op de een of andere manier een soort Mama Smurf voor hen zal zijn...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E74 De Smurfen: Mijn Smurfse Valentijnsdag
programme.desc: Smurfendorp komt helemaal tot leven wanneer Grote Smurf Valentijnsdag aankondigt, een dag om liefde en vriendschap te vieren. De kleine blauwe mannetjes barsten van energie om het jaarlijkse bezoek van Cupido voor te bereiden.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 De Smurfen: Smulpap Smulsmurf
programme.desc: Gulzige Smurf overdrijft het. Hij wordt steeds zwaarder en zwaarder, totdat zijn gewicht hem in gevaar brengt. De gemene Gargamel is van plan om hem te vangen... Kan Gulzige Smurf gered worden door Grote Smurf?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E62 De Smurfen: Smurf Me Geen Bloemen
programme.desc: Arme Luilak Smurf kan niet meer slapen. Hij gelooft dat hij zijn laatste momenten beleeft en besluit om alle spannende dingen te doen waar hij altijd te slaperig voor was...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.desc: Klungel en Smurfin worden gevangen genomen door de gemene Bombast, die van plan is ze in zijn show tentoon te stellen. Grote Smurf haast zich om hen te redden en met behulp van Gargamel kan hij zijn Smurfen redden.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 De Smurfen: Behekst, Bedrogen En Besmurft
programme.desc: De heks Hogatha verliest haar tovermedaillon in het Smurfenbos en overhaalt Gargamel om haar te helpen zoeken. Maar het is Smurfin die het medaillon vindt.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 De Smurfen: Sint Smurfis En De Draak
programme.desc: De Smurfen vinden een babydraakje dat verloren is geraakt in het bos. Ze brengen het terug naar het dorp en zorgen ervoor. Maar de boosaardige Gargamel neemt het kleine wezentje gevangen. Hij wil het gebruiken om het Smurfendorp te vernietigen. Gelukkig is er Grote Smurf die meer dan één trucje kent om te helpen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 De Smurfen: Het Ei En De Smurfen
programme.desc: Gargamel's magische ei belandt in het Smurfendorp waar de kleine blauwe Smurfen de ene gekke wens na de andere doen, wat een totale chaos veroorzaakt. Grote Smurf moet zowel Gargamel als Bolle Gijs te slim af zijn voordat zijn toverdrankjes de schade aan het ei ongedaan maken en de smurfheid weer normaal kan worden.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Boottocht Boottocht
programme.desc: Regen. Naranjina schuilt onder een boom ergens langs de kant van de weg. Daar ontmoet ze Gijsbert, een dakloze die onder bruggen slaapt en zijn weinige spullen in een boodschappenkar meeneemt. Een auto komt hard langsrijden: splash! Een grote golf plenst over hen heen en maakt hen zeiknat. Uit de auto stapt Katharina, die hen een meewarige blik toewerpt: zo, jullie zijn ook weer schoon…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Hulp
programme.desc: Een bordje ‘hulp gevraagd’ hangt bij de viskar. Naranjina heeft net voor iedereen visjes gehaald als Katharina en Jan aan komen lopen. Ze weet zich nergens anders te verstoppen dan onder tafel. Maar hoe komt ze hier weg? Ze bindt Jans’ veters aan elkaar en sprint ervandoor. Jan springt op, struikelt en belandt met zijn hoofd tegen de borsten van Lilka die net aan komt lopen. De verlekkerde grijns op zijn gezicht veegt Katharina er met een vakkundige tik vanaf.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Barbecue
programme.desc: Eerlijkheid. Soms doet ze wel eens iets wat misschien ‘stout’ is. Maar ze is wel altijd eerlijk. Ook zonder dat haar ouders op haar letten. En als ze een probleem veroorzaakt zal ze er alles aan doen om dat weer goed te maken.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Warm!
programme.desc: Het dak van Naranjina’s huis is zo warm geworden dat ze er een eitje op bakt. De anderen zitten onder een boom in de schaduw op een ‘koele’ plek. Freddie zit in een boom/lantaarnpaal op wacht. Ondanks de schaduw heeft Faya het nog steeds te warm, zucht ze… Binnen is het echter nog warmer met de zon die onbarmhartig op het dak schijnt. En het water in de regenton is bijna verdampt. Hitte in de stad…

programme.title: Boes
programme.desc: Boes en Dolly gaan met een vlot de rivier op. Ze hebben een hoop plezier, maar plots verandert het vlot in een jungle waardoor ze niet zien dat ze op een waterval afvaren..

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Boes: Met Boes op stal
programme.desc: Boes begint ’s morgens vroeg met zijn werk, want hij heeft een hoop te doen. Koeien melken, een ongetemd paard trainen, eieren verzamelen en nog veel meer. Het wordt Boes niet makkelijk gemaakt, want de dieren werken vandaag niet echt mee.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Boes: Een pleister op de hond
programme.desc: Er zijn een paar dieren gewond en ziek. Boes moet de hele dag voor hun zorgen. Een splinter in de hond zijn poot lost Boes op door zijn bek dicht te binden en Dolly haar gebroken schild wordt geholpen met plakband. Dat kan niet lang goed gaan!

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Boes: Dollen met de mollen
programme.desc: Boes werkt zich in het zweet op het veld. Terwijl hij werkt pikken de vogels de zojuist gezaaide zaden uit de grond. De mollen zijn echter het vervelendst! Ze vernielen het hele veld. Boes krijgt een idee om de mollen weg te krijgen...

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Boes: Dat is dus een octopus
programme.desc: Boes en Dolly vinden een octopus die bewusteloos op het strand ligt. Ze besluiten zijn leven te redden door lucht in de octopus te pompen. Als de octopus als een balloon begint te drijven, besluiten Boes en Dolly een mand aan de armen van de octopus te binden zodat ze een reis kunnen maken.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De kinderen kijken verbaasd naar de truc van de goochelaar: hij zaagt een persoon in twee stukken. Stradi komt achter het geheim en zal de truc toepassen op zijn zus, terwijl Bass en Celine angstvallig toekijken…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Bass zit te genieten van zijn krant en de zon, als Celine hem vraagt het gras te maaien. Hij laat het liever aan de kinderen over. Die gaan vol enthousiasme aan de slag, maar ze zijn het al gauw beu. Het gevolg is een echte ravage.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi is zeer treurig. Eén van zijn snaren is geknapt. Bass voelt mee met zijn zoon en wil hem helpen. Door het bos trekken ze naar het mysterieuze huis van Maestro, de dirigent.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi, Viola en Pica gaan kamperen. Ze nemen elk hun eigen tent mee. Stradi wil helpen om de tenten op te zetten, maar de meisjes weigeren zijn hulp. Ze doen het liever zelf. Maar in de nacht komt een felle stormwind. Zullen de tenten stand houden?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is nacht. Alles is stil, maar Stradi kan niet slapen. Hij hoort dieven inbreken en naar boven komen. Hij bedenkt een slim plannetje om ze weg te jagen.…

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het regent fel. De kinderen zitten in de klas en krijgen les over de regenboog. Plots verschijnt er een in de lucht, en achter de niets vermoedende juf sluipen de kinderen naar buiten. Ze slagen er zelfs in om de regenboog te beklimmen.

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.sub-title: S02 : E66 De Smurfen: De Slaapwandelende Smurf
programme.desc: Deze keer is Gargamel er zeker van dat hij de ultieme oplossing heeft gevonden voor het vervelende Smurfenvraagstuk. Zijn magische fluit zal hun vredige slaap veranderen in een nachtmerrie...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E70 De Smurfen: De Avonturen Van Robin Smurf
programme.desc: De smurfige theaterproduktie "Robin Smurf" komt tot leven wanneer de legendarisch held door een echte acteur wordt gespeeld.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E61 De Smurfen: Smurfendromen Versmurft
programme.desc: Gargamel heeft een nieuw plan bedacht waarmee hij de Smurfen kan vernietigen: hij gaat nu hun dromen beïnvloeden! Gelukkig heeft Grote Smurf gehoord van de magische Gouden Droomkroon...

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E64 De Smurfen: De Smurfen Op Zee
programme.desc: Grote Smurf denkt terug aan de avontuurlijke reis van Droomsmurf op zee. Zeeschildpadden, walvissen, verlaten eilanden en… piraten spelen door zijn gedachten.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 De Smurfen: De Smurf Die Geen Nee Kon Zeggen
programme.desc: Het is een grote eer voor een Smurf om gevraagd te worden om naar het Moeras te gaan en het zeldzame paddestoel terug te brengen. Maar Bange Smurf aarzelt om de Moerasmonster onder ogen te komen, dus stuurt hij de Smurf die geen nee kan zeggen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Paardenpraat TV: Wat je nooit mag doen
programme.desc: Britt vertelt een aantal dingen die je nooit moet doen in de buurt van de manege of de paarden! Ook krijgen paardenmensen vaak dingen te horen die echt super stom zijn. In deze video vertelt Esra 10 dingen die je nooit meer wilt horen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Paardenpraat TV: Britt en Esra op wedstrijd
programme.desc: Britt en Esra hebben beide een belangrijke wedstrijddag. Hoe zien de voorbereiden hiervoor eruit? Beide nemen jullie mee op pad en laten samen met George en Halloween zien hoe het er precies aan toe gaat op de dag van de wedstrijd.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Dokko's kies
programme.desc: De ijscoman rinkelt met zijn bel. Automatisch springt iedereen verlekkerd op. Naranjina haalt geld uit het potje ‘onvoorzien’ in haar kast vol met geldpotjes, ondanks tegenwerpingen van Lise. Ze koopt voor iedereen, zelfs voor Dokko, ijsjes. Dokko blaft het uit van de pijn als hij een hap neemt.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Siergeit
programme.desc: Naranjina ziet haar stukgetrapte groentetuintje en maakt met een kwast en een stuk metaal een bord. Ze plant het bord met een doodshoofd erop bij een vertrapt groentetuintje: Pas op, verontreinigde grond! Ze hoopt dat Ruben haar tuintje nu met rust zal laten.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Vakantie
programme.desc: Naranjina zwaait de kadekapers uit: prettige vakantie, tot snel! Daarna gaat ze vrolijk terug naar binnen…

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Liefs van Ruben
programme.desc: Naranjina en de kadekapers rennen als gekken over de kade. Dokko rent achter ze aan. Vluchten ze voor Dokko? Nee, ze rennen achter een bankbiljet aan dat wappert op de wind. Uiteindelijk blijft het hoog in een kraan hangen. Naranjina baalt ervan: ze hebben al zo weinig verdiend vandaag.

programme.desc: Mama Ping is het zat om voor haar kinderen te zorgen. Ze wil graag een keer uitrusten en een dutje doen. Mama Ping loopt weg en laat papa Biton achter bij de kleintjes, maar papa kan het niet alleen aan en Boes probeert babysitters in te huren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Boes: Boes vist maar net
programme.desc: Boes gaat vissen en verzamelt een regenworm. De regenworm wil liever niet door een vis worden opgeslokt en probeert te ontsnappen. Boes probeert hem te overtuigen, maar de regenworm wil niet luisteren.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Boes: Liefde doet pijn

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Boes: Held op klompen
programme.desc: Saffie, een waakhond van niets, moet op de kippen passen maar gaat zelf op de eieren zitten. De kippen hebben geen greintje respect voor hem. Het wordt zo erg dat ze zelfs aanpappen met Jantje de vos. Het blijft de hond van boes!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Aira komt op de kinderen passen als Celine en Bass een avondje uitgaan. Haar aandacht gaat echter niet naar de kinderen. Ze wil zelfs geen verhaaltje voorlezen. Ze trekt zich beneden terug met haar eigen griezelverhalen. Stradi en Viola laten dit niet zomaar gebeuren.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is bedtijd. Stradi loopt voorbij de spiegel in de gang, en ziet zichzelf. Midden in de nacht staat hij op. Als hij voorbij de spiegel loopt, ontmoet hij zijn eigen spiegelbeeld. Even zijn er twee Stradi’s. Of niet?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Symfollies: Viola is Ziek
programme.desc: Stradi, Ting Tang en Pica maken een sneeuwpop. De arme Viola kan niet meegenieten: ze ligt ziek in bed. Vanuit haar kamer volgt ze het spel. De kinderen bedenken een manier om Viola bij hun spel te betrekken.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Trump houden een autorace. Maar voor de vrienden van Trump staat het nu al vast dat hij de race moet winnen. Samen smeden ze een complot tegen Stradi. Eens zien wie er zal winnen!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: De familie viool geniet van een dagje aan zee. Tijdens hun spel vinden de kinderen een fles. Er zit een schatkaart in. Stradi en Viola zijn erg nieuwsgierig en gaan op zoek naar de schat.

programme.title: Symfollies

programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 De Smurfen: Droomsmurfs Nachtmerrie

Grote Smurf, die hem probeert te redden, wordt ook gevangengenomen. Maar hij kan ontsnappen dankzij het magische fluitje waardoor hij en Droomsmurf meteen weer in het dorp terechtkomen.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.desc: Dikke reus Bolle Gijs gaat samen met Gargamel op Smurfenjacht zodat hij heerlijke Smurfensoep kan klaarmaken. Grote Smurf haalt een trucje uit met het grote monster. Hij overtuigt hem dat Gargamelsoep veel lekkerder smaakt dan Smurfensoep.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 De Smurfen: De Pluizenplaag
programme.desc: Klungelsmurf brengt een raar wezentje mee naar het dorp. Het is klein en lief maar vermenigvuldigt zich razendsnel en dreigt de dam op te eten. Gelukkig kent Muzieksmurf een deuntje om de wezentjes het bos in te lokken …

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 De Smurfen: Al Wat Glinstert Is Nog Geen Smurf
programme.desc: Gargamel vangt tien Smurfen voor zijn gouden drankje en Grote Smurf plant hun ontsnapping. Hij lokt de sluwe tovenaar het bos in met een berg nepgoud terwijl hij de onwetende Azraël gebruikt om de Smurfen te bevrijden.

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 De Smurfen: De Smurfen In Vuur En Vlam
programme.desc: Lentekriebels zorgen ervoor dat alle Smurfen het hart van Smurfin willen veroveren. Gargamel ziet hierin zijn kans om de Smurfen te vangen en spreekt een betovering uit over Smurfin. Grote Smurf probeert hier een stokje voor te steken en met de hulp van de dwaze kat Azraël kan hij Gargamels plan verijdelen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Het is weer tijd voor een paardenrassen video. Britt en Esra laten je onder andere het fjordenpaard, de Haflinger en de Spaanse Andalusiër zien. Wat maakt deze rassen zo bijzonder? Britt en Esra zoeken het voor jullie uit.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.desc: Hoe kan je het beste een galopwissel rijden? Britt en George laten het vandaag zien. Tijdens een proef moet je dit ook kunnen. Daarna gaat Britt weer lekker op Eve rijden! Het is namelijk een tijdje geleden. Eve heeft het de afgelopen maanden iets rustiger gehad. Britt laat jullie zien hoe ze het rijden weer oppakt met Eve.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Paardenpraat TV: Wat je nooit mag doen
programme.desc: Britt vertelt een aantal dingen die je nooit moet doen in de buurt van de manege of de paarden! Ook krijgen paardenmensen vaak dingen te horen die echt super stom zijn. In deze video vertelt Esra 10 dingen die je nooit meer wilt horen.

programme.title: Paardenpraat TV
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Paardenpraat TV: Op George rijden zonder hoofdstel en zadel
programme.desc: Britt vond het heerlijk om lekker zonder zadel op Vito te rijden. Op George heeft ze nog niet zo vaak zonder zadel gereden! Britt en George blijven oefenen om steeds beter te worden. Eerst gaat Britt oefenen met George zonder zadel en op muziek, om George te laten wennen. Vervolgens gaat ze op George zonder hoofdstel rijden. Als dat maar goed gaat!

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Jarig
programme.desc: Faya staat geblinddoekt op een bijzondere plek, hoog in de haven. Voor de gelegenheid hebben de kadekapers en Naranjina een veiligheidshelm opgezet. Als Faya de blinddoek wegdoet zingen de anderen happy birthday. Faya is jarig en haar vrienden hebben een extravagante hoed voor haar gekocht.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Horoscoop
programme.desc: Naranjina wil zichzelf leren om een kompas te lezen en loopt geconcentreerd door de haven, kijkend op haar kompas. Als ze een hoek omslaat botst ze tegen Ruben op, die haar wil grijpen. Ze rent de benen uit haar lijf en weet te ontsnappen, maar ze verliest wel haar kompas.

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Kamperen
programme.desc: Naranjina ligt te slapen als er plots een lading schillen in haar gezicht vallen. Wat gebeurt er?

programme.title: Naranjina & De Kadekapers
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Naranjina & De Kadekapers: Vork en mes
programme.desc: Naranjina heeft met Abduls hulp een roetsjbaan met een wadeboard en zeep gemaakt. Het gaat fantastisch, tot ze een keurige vrouw onderuitglijdt… Het blijkt de tante van Lise die op het punt staat om aan boord van een vakantie schip te gaan. Eigenlijk was het niet Abduls bedoeling om roetsjbaan te bouwen, maar een sluizen systeem.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Boes: Boes in de put
programme.desc: De put loopt droog. Als Boes begint te graven om water te krijgen, bereikt hij uiteindelijk het middelpunt van de aarde. Maar hierdoor gebeurt er van alles in de wereld waar Boes niet aan had gedacht..

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Boes: Vliegensvlug naar het nest
programme.desc: Overal worden er vogeltjes geboren. Boes vindt de nestjes te klein en besluit kastjes te maken. Hoe hij ook zijn best doet, de vogels vinden zijn creaties maar niets en komen er niet bij in de buurt. Het blijkt dat Boes de enige is die ze mooi vindt!

programme.title: Boes
programme.desc: Het huis van Boes is ijskoud. Het schild van Dolly is helemaal bevroren en zij kan haar kop niet meer bewegen. Boes probeert haar te helpen maar haar schild valt uit elkaar. De kale naakte Dolly krijgt het natuurlijk ijskoud. Als dit maar goed afloopt...

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 Boes: Paard roert met z'n staart
programme.desc: Het ongetemde paard is zo wild dat hij zich niet door Boes laat temmen. Boes probeert op zijn manier vrienden met hem te worden, maar het paard negeert hem. Uiteindelijk slaagt Boes erin een zadel op hem te zetten, maar of het paard dit ook leuk vindt is nog maar de vraag.

programme.title: Boes
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Boes: Hé, dat is mijn melk
programme.desc: Een pasgeboren kalf drinkt bij zijn moeder. Ondertussen komt er een mol alle melk stelen. Het kalfje wordt boos en begint aan alle uiers te zuigen. Als Boes de moeder komt melken, wordt het kalf helemaal boos en gaat achter Boes aan.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Stradi en Viola maken kaartenhuisjes, maar bij Stradi wil het niet lukken. Hij wordt boos. Tot groot ongenoegen van Viola wil hij het probleem oplossen met lijm. Hun ruzie loopt zo hoog op, dat het met de allesklevende lijm gevaarlijk wordt.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Het is kermis. Alle bewoners zijn aanwezig, en het is echt gezellig. Trump en Tromb proberen het feest te saboteren. Wat kunnen ze doen met de draaimolen, de fotostand en de toverhoed van Legato?

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: In de ruïnes van het oude kasteel speelt Bass een heldenrol in een film. Hij is fier op het resultaat. Maar door een onvoorzichtigheid van Stradi en Viola wordt de filmband erg beschadigd. De kinderen lossen het wel op hun manier op!

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb willen op een snelle manier geld verdienen. Ze blazen de brug van het dorp op, en plaatsen een vervangbrug. Daar innen ze tolgeld. De anderen beginnen een nieuwe brug te bouwen. Maar dat laten de twee boeven niet zomaar gebeuren.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Trump en Tromb hebben verschillende voorwerpen gestolen uit het kasteel. Ze verbergen die in een zelfgebouwde boomhut. Stradi en Viola ontdekken de hut op een van hun vele uitstapjes.

programme.title: Symfollies
programme.desc: Koningin Harp en Maestro organiseren een sneeuwrace voor alle kinderen. Ieder mag een eigen vervoermiddel kiezen. Wat zal het vlugste zijn: een bobslee, een snowboard, een slee, een houten plank of een prachtige koets?

programme.desc: Ernst en Bobbie komen er achter dat het lijkt of de clowns in het Circus geld hebben gestolen. De circusdirecteur gelooft daar niets van en zegt dat dat bij hun act hoort. Toch vertrouwen Ernst en Bobbie het niet.

programme.title: Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Ernst, Bobbie en de Rest - Avonturen bij het Circus: De Onvergetelijke Dag
programme.desc: De kleindochters van de burgemeester zijn op bezoek. Ernst en Bobbie willen de meiden graag een onvergetelijke dag bezorgen. Alleen loopt alles mis; de meiden stappen op een verkeerde motor en Ernst en Bobbie belanden in de gevangenis….Komt dit goed?

programme.desc: De Cry Babies Magic Tears, Pia en Griffo, zijn aan het wandelen in Tutti Frutti-baai wanneer Pia uitglijdt over een bananenschil. Die is van Nana! Ze gooit altijd de schillen op de grond…

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 De Smurfen: De Onderaardse Smurfen
programme.desc: Er dreigt hongersnood bij de Smurfen. Op hun zoektocht naar eten vinden de uitgehongerde Smurfen een voorraad bevroren voedsel, bewaakt door een bevroren trol, in een mysterieuze grot. De grot herbergt ook een magische diamant. Wanneer de Smurfen de grot ontdooien, probeert Gargamel het voedsel te stelen.

programme.desc: Gedurende één van zijn wandelingen vindt Knustelsmurf een kristallen bol. Deze kristallen bol toont de innerlijke wensen van degene die ernaar kijkt. Deze werd gemaakt door onderaardse trollen die op zoek zijn naar slaven om in hun mijnen te werken.

Wanneer zijn ware aard weer boven komt, spreekt Grote Smurf een magische formule uit om zijn Smurfjes te redden uit de handen van de gemene tovenaar.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E35 De Smurfen: De Smurfen En De Geldboom
programme.desc: Gargamel krijgt hulp van zijn moeder om de Smurfen te vangen. Ze hebben het geweldige idee om de Smurfen proberen te verleiden met geld. Deze kennen het gebruik van geld niet. Zal Smulsmurf zich echter laten vangen?

programme.title: De Smurfen
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 De Smurfen: Een Robotsmurf
programme.desc: Knutsel heeft een robot ontworpen die alle klusjes moet opknappen. Maar Brilsmurf heeft ermee geknoeid en Robotsmurf verlaat het dorp. Hij komt terecht in een kasteel. Daar overtuigt hij een jonge prins om naar het smurfendorp te gaan en de Smurfen om hulp te vragen om zo zijn koninkrijk terug te winnen van zijn boosaardige tante.

programme.title: De Smurfen

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.

programme.title: BP Ultimate Rally Raid Portugal 2026
programme.desc: The BP Ultimate Rally-Raid joined the W2RC calendar in 2024. The competition on Portuguese and Spanish tracks is always unforgettable for both cars and motorcycles. The event, organized by the Automóvel Club de Portugal, counts as the second round of the calendar. The rally offers a 1,200-kilometer route with wide and varied tracks: from the vast sandy beaches of the Alentejo coast to the busy roads of the Ribatejo region, not forgetting the rocky tracks of the Extremadura province in Spain. Diversity is the key word for the five days of racing! The bivouac is set up in the heart of the town of Grândola, in the province of Setúbal, 100 kilometers south of Lisbon.
